result.summary: The home feed shows a raw localization key instead of a title, a restaurant name is clipped, and the last card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: Section heading displays the untranslated key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render raw keys.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is truncated by the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, slightly reduce type size, or make the horizontal list fully scrollable so names remain fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding most of the listing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Category chips on the right are clipped, implying more options without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek of the next chip or a visible scroll indicator so users know they can swipe.
